proposals.before: He diverted Jinzho mining funds to build telegraph lines in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong for military use; the ministry found his accounts unclear and ordered him demoted and transferred.
proposals.after: He diverted Jinzhou mining funds to build telegraph lines in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong for military use; the ministry found his accounts unclear and ordered him demoted and transferred.
proposals.reason: 金州 is Jinzhou; "Jinzho" is a truncated misspelling in the idiomatic English.

proposals.before: Studying the causes of calamity, he devoted himself further to waterworks; his regulation of the Xiaoxiao River brought especially wide benefit.
proposals.after: Studying the causes of calamity, he devoted himself further to waterworks; his regulation of the Xiaoqing River brought especially wide benefit.
proposals.reason: 小清河 is the Xiaoqing River; "Xiaoxiao" misreads 清 as a reduplicated 小.

proposals.before: Investigating causes of disaster, he devoted himself further to water conservancy; his work on the Xiaoxiao River was especially beneficial.
proposals.after: Investigating causes of disaster, he devoted himself further to water conservancy; his work on the Xiaoqing River was especially beneficial.
proposals.reason: Same Xiaoqing River correction for the literal field.

proposals.before: Rui Cheng, whose style name was Xinru, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, grandson of Grand Secretary Qishan and son of General Gongjin.
proposals.after: Rui Cheng, whose style name was Xinru, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, grandson of Grand Secretary Qishan and son of General Gongtang.
proposals.reason: 恭鏜 is Gongtang; "Gongjin" is an incorrect English rendering of 鏜.

proposals.after: Rui Cheng, style name Xinru, was a Plain Yellow Banner Manchu, grandson of Grand Secretary Qishan and son of General Gongtang.

decisions.reason: s0014 has 金州; standard pinyin is Jinzhou, and "Jinzho" is a truncated misspelling with no other change to the sentence.
s0082 has 小清河 (Xiaoqing River); "Xiaoxiao" wrongly reduplicates 小 and drops 清, so the proposed replacement is the accurate toponym.
The same focus phrase 小清河 is mistranslated as Xiaoxiao River in the literal field; Xiaoqing River correctly renders 小清河.
s0084 names 將軍恭鏜; 鏜 is tang, so Gongtang is the correct English name and Gongjin is a mistranslation.
The same focus phrase 將軍恭鏜 is rendered Gongjin in the literal field; Gongtang restores the correct reading of 鏜.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0004 shows alternate name Gongjin for 恭鏜 arose only from the mistranslation; s0084 supports Gongtang (c0072), not a separate Gongjin alias.
